name: Display Role
description: Allows administrators to configure roles to display on user profiles.
project_description: Display Role adds a 'Roles' pseudo-field to the user entity's display so administrators can show a user's assigned roles on their profile page. Enable the module and go to People » Account settings » Manage display, then place the 'Roles' component where you want it relative to other display elements such as 'Picture' and 'Member for'. Roles then render as an item list, and because the component participates in the user display they are also reachable from the user.html.twig template without writing a preprocess function. An optional, UI-less config flag (displayrole.settings:append_role_to_username) can additionally append the role list in parentheses to rendered usernames. The module ships only a .module hook file (no routes, permissions, services, or plugins) and depends solely on Drupal core's user module.
